newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not tested Friday - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not tested Friday - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis, compared with Thursday, USDA said. Trade was slow. Demand and seller interest light.
